protocol.learning_rate: local cosine 1e-5 to 1e-6; added branch 10x; 1500 new updates
protocol.initialization: identical selected short-context e5 parent (1500 prior updates); fresh seed0 new branch
protocol.exposure: repeat the same admitted 5-epoch training schedule for both arms; no new recordings
protocol.preparation_used_for: data and feature schedule only; old initialization/optimizer fields ignored
protocol.selection: minimum validation mean NMSE across counts 2 and 3, include epoch0; report count1 separately
protocol.acceptance: both counts 2/3 NMSE lower AND complex SI-SDR higher; one-seed development only
protocol.context: same local waveform path and mean power features; added complex branch sees masked/local or full 10.48576ms IQ
protocol.packing: lossless pack16 before learned strided context encoding; subsequent features are lossy
protocol.main_contrast: identical dual-path model; added context branch alone changes observed IQ; context normalization response also changes
protocol.fusion: last decoder64 + time-aligned context128 -> Conv3 192/64 -> SiLU -> Conv1 64/64 -> additive local feature correction; scored-area centers only
protocol.train_only_gate: 32 discarded updates on fixed four train mixtures per arm; finite gradients and lower objective and unscaled NMSE required before validation
protocol.complex_context: four learned stride4 convs after lossless pack16; 256 ordered tokens; seven two-conv dilated TCN blocks
protocol.interpretation: learned context compression is not guaranteed lossless; no claim of pure periodicity effect

local_power_gap_analysis: posthoc descriptive; no exclusions or reselection
